literal: Without approaching, him who left, in heart do we possess? Still we will lose beauty.
translation: Do we still hold in our heart the lover who left us without an embrace? If so, we will only lose our beauty even more.
modern: நம்மை நெருங்காமல் பிரிந்து சென்றவரை நாம் இன்னும் நெஞ்சில் கொண்டிருக்கிறோமா? அப்படியானால் நாம் நமது அழகை இன்னும் இழந்துவிடுவோம்.
explanation: The heroine addresses her own heart in a moment of deep sorrow over her unrequited longing. She questions why they still hold onto the memory of a lover who abandoned them without showing any closeness or affection. She realizes that keeping him constantly in her thoughts will only cause her to pine away and lose whatever beauty she has left.
